about: Files this project must NOT redistribute. They are taken from files the user owns or downloaded (Switchroot files read as-is; Switchroot is NOT installed on the Switch) and staged outside the repository. 'sha256' / 'size' are only filled in where a published value exists (windows-switch v0.8.0 ADD_THESE_FILES.txt / PUT_*_HERE.txt); everything else is trust-on-first-use and is marked unverified in the report. 'layout' says how sure we are about WHERE the file sits: documented = named by an upstream document, guess = a plausible path that has not been checked on a real image (the hash check rejects wrong guesses where a hash exists).

not_needed: No Nintendo-owned file (Horizon system firmware, keys, game data) is read by this tool. Nothing in the current driver set was found to require one. Per-console data such as Joy-Con pairing is not handled here.
bpmpfw.bin / bpmpfw_b01.bin / mtc_tbl_b01.bin: hekate l4t.c says BPMP-FW is not used on T210 (Erista) and sc7entry is used instead; the b01 files are Mariko-only.
